name: Deep house groove
notes: A whole deep house loop: a 909 kick that pumps the bass, Rhodes and pad on lane 2, plus swung hats. Mute a part with a leading underscore.
code:
setcpm(122/4)

// The kick ducks lane 2 (bass, keys, pad): the sidechain pump
drums: s("bd:3*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.65).duckorbit(2).duckattack(0.18).duckdepth(0.7)
claps: s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5).room(0.2)
hats: s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.42).hpf(5000).pan(0.6)
shaker: s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain(perlin.range(0.1, 0.25)).hpf(8000).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65).slow(4)).swingBy(1/48, 4)
bass: note("<[~ f1]*4 [~ f1]*4 [~ db1]*4 [~ eb1 ~ eb1 ~ eb1 ~ eb2]>").s("sine").fm(1.5).fmh(1).fmdecay(0.1).decay(0.3).sustain(0.4).shape(0.3).lpf(600).gain(0.5).orbit(2)
keys: chord("<Fm9 Fm9 Db^9 Eb9sus>").voicing().struct("[~ x] ~ [~ x] [~ ~ x ~]").s("gm_epiano1").velocity(perlin.range(0.6, 0.9)).gain(0.8).room(0.35).delay(0.2).delaytime(0.37).delayfeedback(0.35).orbit(2)
pad: chord("<Fm9 Fm9 Db^9 Eb9sus>").voicing().s("supersaw").unison(5).detune(0.18).spread(0.9).attack(0.5).release(1.5).lpf(sine.range(700, 1900).slow(16)).lpq(2).gain(0.2).room(0.6).roomsize(5).orbit(2)
